classification: NON-PRODUCTION requalification of the unchanged Aux5 producer on the new glibc of rebaseguard-vultr-02; its records are never production cells and are never composed into any production ledger

source_protocol.rule: every original requirement is kept verbatim; this protocol adds host binding and criterion Q6

preconditions: HOST_CONTAINMENT_PLAN.md applied with explicit operator approval, POST_STATE recorded, and every host fact below still equal
no process of either CUSUM production generation and no qualification run is live on the host
the terminal predecessor runtime root is not read for writing and is not used as an output location

runs.resume: none (--skip-if-current NOT used); every run recomputes from scratch
runs.checkout: a separate clean git worktree at the Aux5 freeze commit d31ea4edd5a96be5c9ac0a7d4acea2a5a3c5e563 (the source protocol's 'clean git checkout of the freeze commit'); the manifest v3 initial and final gates must pass; the production checkout /root/work/postk1-aux5 is not used
runs.output_location: a new directory outside the repository and outside both CUSUM production runtime roots

software.openblas_config: OpenBLAS 0.3.34.0.0  USE64BITINT DYNAMIC_ARCH NO_AFFINITY Haswell MAX_THREADS=64

producer.pre_execution_evidence: frozen C06 env -i runtime probe PASS under deb13u4 on 2026-09-14 (producer identity and runtime contract unchanged)

host.drift_rule: any difference in these facts before or during requalification is a FAIL (no retry)

acceptance.P1: all 4 runs exit 0; final gate stage == final; provenance_chain.all_verified; scipy_guard.scipy_free
acceptance.P2: per cell, scientific_content_hash identical across its 2 repeats
acceptance.P3: per cell, every certificates.*.certificate_hash identical across its 2 repeats
acceptance.P4: every record's runtime_contract_hash and producer_identity_hash equal the frozen manifest v3 identity (bc75c9ea..., 3692d0fe...)
acceptance.P5: every record's producer.runtime.backend_libraries is non-empty and contains the four required families by absolute path
acceptance.Q6: for each cell and each repeat, scientific_content_hash equals config/Q6_REFERENCE.json (318: 01ff4f7a2632102475805537f439ccbe7932b68339eafa37d5ecdd03c13edda9, 323: 054a5ef0cd932ddcac3b4b2dc1a9b461e353ae6b51a2d726a5ccbc9607e57077) AND the full certificates.*.certificate_hash map (28 certificates per cell) equals the reference map exactly; no run record is byte-identical to a predecessor qualification record

verdict_rule: PASS iff P1-P5 and Q6 all hold; otherwise FAIL (no retry, no tolerance)
on_q6_failure_effect: no successor production may launch under GLIBC_SUCCESSOR_PROPOSAL; a new governance decision is required
predecessor_bit_identity_required: YES for carry-over (Q6); it is not a producer-qualification criterion in the source protocol

measurements.c_max: max over the 4 runs of cpu_seconds_including_dependencies (CPU-s)
measurements.cap_consequence: the absolute campaign cap stays 300 CPU-h; the frozen formula gives 300 for c_max <= 2431.904 CPU-s; a larger c_max is a governance stop, never a raise (config/CPU_CAP_CONTINUITY.json)

cpu_accounting: requalification CPU is excluded from the campaign cap and disclosed in the result

transition_to_production.rule: a Q6 PASS makes carry-over ELIGIBLE_FOR_REVIEW only; production requires independent review, an active countersignature and a successor checkpoint
